transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a 600-kilogram shipment of battery-grade graphite powder that arrived at receiving this morning. It's needed for the electrode-compounding run scheduled for later this week, and the supplier, product description, and quantity all match the purchase order. Before I authorize moving this material into production, I need to go through our normal receiving routine. Could I get quality, logistics, and EHS to weigh in on their release requirements for this shipment?
